sentences.text:
------
CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Gaurav, Advocate For the Opp. Party : Mr. Someshwar Roy, A.P.P.
-----
2/ 01.12.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jaldega (Bansjor) P.S. Case No. 51 of 2025 for the offences registered under Sections 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Simdega.
3. On the pretext of marriage, the petitioner is alleged to have established physical relationship with the prosecutrix.
Thereafter, he refused to marry her.
4. Considering the nature of allegation, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.
20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Special Judge (POCSO), Simdega, in connection with Jaldega (Bansjor) P.S. Case No. 51 of 2025.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) R.Kr.
